question: Were there any boats harbored in Aalborg on 22 October 2025 at 17:00?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT mmsi, arg_max(sog, ts) AS sog FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2025-10-22' AND lon BETWEEN 9.95 AND 10.074 AND lat BETWEEN 57.044 AND 57.071 AND ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-10-22 17:00:00' - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-22 17:00:00' GROUP BY mmsi) WHERE sog < 0.5
definition: harbored at a moment

question: Did Storebælt or Lillebælt have more ships pass under them in January 2026?
sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT mmsi) AS n FROM vessel_positions WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31' AND sog >= 1 AND lon BETWEEN 10.855 AND 11.09 AND lat BETWEEN 55.30 AND 55.355), b AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT mmsi) AS n FROM vessel_positions WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31' AND sog >= 1 AND lon BETWEEN 9.66 AND 9.74 AND lat BETWEEN 55.495 AND 55.525)
SELECT CASE WHEN a.n > b.n THEN 'Great Belt Bridge' WHEN b.n > a.n THEN 'Little Belt bridges' END AS more_in, a.n AS great_belt_bridge, b.n AS little_belt_bridges FROM a, b
definition: moving vessels inside each bridge box in January 2026

question: What was the average speed of boats in the area around Bornholm on May 15 2026?
sql: SELECT round(avg(sog), 2) AS avg_sog FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-05-15' AND lon BETWEEN 14.50 AND 15.40 AND lat BETWEEN 54.85 AND 55.45
definition: average sog over all reports in Bornholm waters

question: What was the average size of boats in the area around Bornholm on April 18 2026?
sql: SELECT round(avg(length), 1) AS avg_length_m FROM (SELECT mmsi, max(length) AS length FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-04-18' AND lon BETWEEN 14.50 AND 15.40 AND lat BETWEEN 54.85 AND 55.45 AND length > 0 GROUP BY mmsi)
definition: average length, each vessel once

question: Are there any boats bigger than 500 meters in length that visited Aalborg during the month of July 2026?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT mmsi) AS vessels FROM vessel_positions WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31' AND length > 500 AND lon BETWEEN 9.95 AND 10.074 AND lat BETWEEN 57.044 AND 57.071
definition: vessels with an AIS length over 500 m in the Aalborg box; no real ship is that long, so any found are length errors

question: Which place had more boats harbored, Aalborg or Esbjerg at 03:23 June 30 2026?
sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT mmsi, arg_max(sog, ts) AS sog FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-06-30' AND lon BETWEEN 9.95 AND 10.074 AND lat BETWEEN 57.044 AND 57.071 AND ts > TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 03:23:00' - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 03:23:00' GROUP BY mmsi) WHERE sog < 0.5), b AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT mmsi, arg_max(sog, ts) AS sog FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-06-30' AND lon BETWEEN 8.40 AND 8.47 AND lat BETWEEN 55.44 AND 55.49 AND ts > TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 03:23:00' - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ts <= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-30 03:23:00' GROUP BY mmsi) WHERE sog < 0.5)
SELECT CASE WHEN a.n > b.n THEN 'Aalborg' WHEN b.n > a.n THEN 'Esbjerg' END AS more_in, a.n AS aalborg, b.n AS esbjerg FROM a, b
definition: harbored at a moment, both ports

  WHERE date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-29' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND sog IS NOT NULL
), g AS (
  SELECT *, sum(CASE WHEN slow THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mmsi ORDER BY ts) AS grp FROM r
), seg AS (
  SELECT mmsi, max(ts) AS t1 FROM g WHERE slow GROUP BY mmsi, grp
  HAVING max(ts) - min(ts) >= INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND CAST(min(ts) AS DATE) = DATE '2026-09-29'
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT seg.mmsi) AS vessels FROM seg JOIN r ON r.mmsi = seg.mmsi
  AND r.ts > seg.t1 AND r.ts <= seg.t1 + INTERVAL 12 HOUR AND r.sog > 10.7991

question: Are there currently more ships docked in Skagen or Frederikshavn
sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT mmsi) AS n FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-09-30' AND sog < 0.5 AND lon BETWEEN 10.55 AND 10.65 AND lat BETWEEN 57.70 AND 57.74), b AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT mmsi) AS n FROM vessel_positions WHERE date = DATE '2026-09-30' AND sog < 0.5 AND lon BETWEEN 10.52 AND 10.60 AND lat BETWEEN 57.42 AND 57.45)
SELECT CASE WHEN a.n > b.n THEN 'Skagen' WHEN b.n > a.n THEN 'Frederikshavn' END AS more_in, a.n AS skagen, b.n AS frederikshavn FROM a, b
definition: currently = 30 September 2026 (docked at any time that day)
